payload.title: [anthus-site-content] 12 articles link to retired Plexus URLs (/platform/plexus, plexus.anth.us, GitHub Plexus)
payload.description:
**Problem**
Twelve articles link to /platform/plexus, plexus.anth.us and the GitHub Plexus repo. These redirect, since the product was renamed to Primus.

**Evidence**
Audit crawl of anth.us (193 pages): 12 articles with such links.

**Fix**
Update links to the Primus locations. See also the related item that the word "Plexus" itself appears in 21 places.

**How to verify**
`grep -rn 'platform/plexus\|plexus.anth.us' content/` prints nothing.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
